coverage_notes.ocha_result: No new in-window OCHA OPT operational update surfaced.
coverage_notes.who_result: No new in-window WHO Gaza operational update surfaced.
coverage_notes.additional_coverage: Exactly 12 targeted searches covered Reuters and AP civilian casualties and military operations, UNRWA, Palestine Red Crescent, WFP, UNICEF, ICRC, crossings and aid access, ceasefire negotiations, hospital and medical-evacuation changes, and displacement/infrastructure damage.
coverage_notes.exclusions: The AP rolling Middle East report repeated the already-captured central Gaza civilian-vehicle strike and Deniz Feneri aid-volunteer death. Reuters Connect funeral footage restated the already-captured Deir al-Balah vehicle-strike casualty. Older, unrelated, duplicate, opinion, unsupported social, and unsourced material were excluded.
